title: Hidden APIs in Language Models: Discovering Reusable Causal Interfaces from Forked Futures
abstract: arXiv:2607.27617v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Identical language-model answers can arise from hidden states that support different future computations, so current-answer probes do not establish a reusable internal interface. We introduce forked futures: future operations are sampled only after a prefix state has formed, and states are compared through the response distributions induced by those operations. This yields an empirical causal quotient over hidden states without requiring researcher-specified latent labels. Shared, Local, Mixture, and Distributed interfaces then compete under prequential causal description length subject to future-signature fidelity and matched capacity constraints. In the two detailed model evaluations, Shared has the lowest held-out description length, with gains of 0.216 nats on Qwen2.5-1.5B and 0.294 nats on Llama-3-8B, while maintaining tightly clustered mean future-signature distortion; a five-backbone sweep preserves the positive direction of S

translated_title: 语言模型中的隐藏API：从分岔未来中发现可复用的因果接口
translated_abstract: 相同的语言模型答案可能来自支持不同未来计算的隐藏状态，因此基于当前答案的探测方法无法建立可复用的内部接口。我们引入了“分岔未来”（forked futures）概念：只有在前缀状态形成之后才对未来的操作进行采样，并通过这些操作所诱导的响应分布来比较不同的状态。这种方法在不依赖研究者指定的潜在标签的情况下，得到了关于隐藏状态的经验因果商数。随后，共享接口、局部接口、混合接口和分布式接口在预quential因果描述长度指标下进行竞争，同时受未来签名保真度和匹配容量约束。在两项详细的模型评估中，共享接口具有最低的留出集描述长度，在Qwen2.5-1.5B上获得0.216 nats的增益，在Llama-3-8B上获得0.294 nats的增益，同时保持紧密聚集的平均未来签名失真；五骨干模型的扫描结果保持了S的正向……
tldr: 提出一种“分岔未来”新方法，通过比较前缀状态所诱导的未来响应分布，无需人工标注即可发现语言模型中可复用的隐藏因果接口，并证明共享接口在因果描述长度指标上显著优于局部、混合和分布式接口。
en_tdlr: Proposes a "forked futures" method that discovers reusable hidden causal interfaces in language models by comparing future response distributions induced from prefix states without manual labels, demonstrating that the Shared interface achieves the lowest prequential causal description length compared to Local, Mixture, and Distributed interfaces.
